body:
A (partial-ish) fix for public issue #28150 / internal issue [#11824](https://github.com/duckdblabs/duckdb-internal/issues/11824), and a follow up to [PR #28663](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/28663).

`UPDATE EXTENSIONS` now updates _all_ extensions, including those in user-provided repos. However `UPDATE EXTENSIONS x` still only scans the default extension directory, and not any subdirectories housed under `<ext_directory>/repositories/<user-provided>`. This is because we now have the possibility of having two extensions installed with the same name. I have a follow up issue for this, as it was determined that fixing `UPDATE EXTENSIONS` is sufficient for `v2.0.1` (cc @carlopi).
